main_text.p: Et: Sed dator veniæ concessâ veniâ Permanentem gratiæ obtentâ gratiâ In nobis habitet, &c.
main_text.head: V. FESTO VISITATIONIS Mariæ. 2. Jul.
main_text.p: Institutum est in Concilio Basiliensi anno Domini 1432. ad supplicandum litandumq; Mariæ, ut Turcos Christianis infestos perdurat, quemadmodum ipsa montes Judææ cavisset in isto ad cognatam suam itinere.

page.notes: Printed text is partly faded at the edges; the catchword at lower right reads "Veni" in heavy print and is uncertain. Some words in the verse lines (e.g. "ut quoque", "robores") are doubtful. The line "Ne fluctuetur" appears as "Ne fluctuetur" in print.
